title: Low-Level Design (Firmware Workflow)

node_notes.entry: The ESP-IDF hook `app_main` begins the startup path by calling `app_start`. This delegation is implemented in `main/entry.c:4`.
node_notes.app: The application logs `firmware started` at informational level and then returns. The call is in `firmware/app/app.c:7-9`.
